Brief Description
Describes the frames that are used in the Data Link Layer
Description
Describes the layout of frames to be sent over communication channels. This definition belongs to
the Data Link Layer. The Data Link Layer provides the functional and procedural means to transfer
data between network entities. This layer is used to transmit data passed by an upper layer (PduR,
Tp) between adjacent network nodes. In AUTOSAR the Drivers (FrDrv, CanDrv, LinDrv) and
Interfaces (FrIf, CanIf, LinIf) belong to the Data Link Layer.
